title: Reconstructed Facsimiles as Written Session Artifacts
summary: In context-reconstructive mode, reconstructed facsimiles (work decomposition and orientation summary always; vocabulary and testable behaviors optionally, for substantial sessions) are written as lightweight markdown files during Context Gathering rather than kept only in conversation. They live in a gitignored `session/` directory, marked with a `session-artifact: true` frontmatter flag, and are explicitly non-permanent and distinct from the RDD artifact trail; after the session the user discards, promotes, or leaves them in place.
mechanism: lightweight markdown session artifacts in a gitignored session/ directory

links.note: Session artifacts are intentionally outside ADR-031's scope: ADR-031 governs provenance-durable artifact-mediated communication, while session artifacts are ephemeral working-memory externalization written for pragmatic reasons (surviving context compression), not architectural provenance.
